WITH q4_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        carrier,
        shipped_at,
        delivered_at,
        CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NOT NULL
             THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400.0
        END AS transit_days
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_at >= DATE '2025-10-01'
      AND shipped_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
carrier_stats AS (
    SELECT
        carrier,
        COUNT(*) AS shipments_shipped,
        COUNT(delivered_at) AS shipments_delivered,
        AVG(transit_days) AS avg_transit_days,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY transit_days) AS median_transit_days,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY transit_days) AS p90_transit_days,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN transit_days <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS delivered_within_3_days
    FROM q4_shipments
    GROUP BY carrier
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(shipments_shipped) AS total_q4_shipments
    FROM carrier_stats
)
SELECT
    cs.carrier,
    cs.shipments_shipped,
    cs.shipments_delivered,
    ROUND(cs.avg_transit_days::numeric, 2) AS avg_transit_days,
    ROUND(cs.median_transit_days::numeric, 2) AS median_transit_days,
    ROUND(cs.p90_transit_days::numeric, 2) AS p90_transit_days,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.delivered_within_3_days / NULLIF(cs.shipments_delivered, 0), 1) AS pct_within_3_days,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.shipments_delivered / NULLIF(cs.shipments_shipped, 0), 1) AS pct_delivered,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.shipments_shipped / NULLIF(t.total_q4_shipments, 0), 1) AS share_of_q4_shipments_pct
FROM carrier_stats cs
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY cs.shipments_shipped DESC, cs.carrier ASC

        COUNT(*) AS shipments_shipped,

totals AS (

    FROM carrier_stats
)
SELECT
    cs.carrier,
    cs.shipments_shipped,
    cs.shipments_delivered,
    ROUND(cs.avg_transit_days::numeric, 2) AS avg_transit_days,
    ROUND(cs.median_transit_days::numeric, 2) AS median_transit_days,
    ROUND(cs.p90_transit_days::numeric, 2) AS p90_transit_days,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.delivered_within_3_days / NULLIF(cs.shipments_delivered, 0), 1) AS pct_within_3_days,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.shipments_delivered / NULLIF(cs.shipments_shipped, 0), 1) AS pct_delivered,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.shipments_shipped / NULLIF(t.total_q4_shipments, 0), 1) AS share_of_q4_shipments_pct
FROM carrier_stats cs
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY cs.shipments_shipped DESC, cs.carrier ASC
note: Grouped by carrier name across all tenants/merchants (the request was carrier-level, not merchant-level); transit_days computed in fractional days then rounded, so avg/median/p90 reflect exact hour-level transit not just whole days. As requested, pct_delivered and pct_within_3_days for carriers with many late-December shipments may be understated due to the 2025-12-31 data cutoff (right-censoring), not necessarily worse carrier performance.

Submitted. Summary of what was delivered:

- **Grain:** one row per carrier, for shipments with `shipped_at` in Q4 2025 (2025-10-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive).
- **Metrics:** shipments_shipped, shipments_delivered, avg/median/p90 transit days (fractional-day precision, rounded to 2 decimals), pct_within_3_days and pct_delivered (rounded to 1 decimal, % scale), and each carrier's share of total Q4 shipment volume.
- **Ordering:** shipments_shipped descending, carrier ascending as tie-break — no row cap applied, so all ~14 carriers will print.
- **Caveat flagged in the note:** late-December shipments may still be in transit as of the 2025-12-31 cutoff, so pct_delivered/pct_within_3_days can understate carriers with heavy late-month volume (right-censoring), not necessarily worse service.
